name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: ממשלת חילופים (תיקוני חקיקה)
reason: Amends rotation government mechanism, not prime minister's solo power
r2: Separate Basic Law for rotation government; bloc-affiliation rules on ministers, effect on PM's unilateral power unclear from excerpt.

name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: הממשלה (תיקון מס' 13)
reason: Shields prime minister's minister appointments from added eligibility conditions
r2: Bars judicial review of PM's appointment and dismissal of ministers; frees PM's appointment power.

name: הצעת חוק הוועדה המייעצת למינויים בכירים
reason: Advisory vetting committee for top security appointments
r2: Creates statutory advisory committee vetting top security appointments (army chief, police, Shin Bet, Mossad); checks PM.

name: חוק-יסוד: הממשלה (תיקון מס' 10)
reason: Rotation government bloc mechanics, not prime minister's solo power
r2: Rotation-government amendment preserving parity between PM and alternate PM blocs; constrains PM over ministers.

name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: הפסקת חברות של חבר כנסת והעברת שר וראש ממשלה מכהונתם מחמת הפרת הבטחת בחירות (תיקוני חקיקה)
reason: Removal for broken election promises; accountability, not appointment powers
r2: Allows removing MK, minister or PM for breaking election promises; adds accountability check on PM.
